title: Elvis Dinner Show Cruise on Lake Minnetonka
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Sail around Lake Minnetonka while enjoying the best of Elvis in a unique dinner show experience. With a performance celebrating 90 memories of the King, this cruise brings back the iconic songs that defined an era. Indulge in a delicious Italian buffet dinner featuring Chicken Fettuccine Alfredo and assorted dessert bars, all while soaking in the serene lake views. This special event runs on select Sundays from May to October, making it an ideal outing for music lovers and families looking for a memorable night out. 

- 2-hour cruise featuring live Elvis tribute performance 
- Delicious Italian buffet dinner included with your ticket 
- Cash bar available for refreshing drinks 
- Perfect for families and Elvis fans alike.
